COINOP_CHAIN_ID.description: 84532 = Base Sepolia (live today, test USDC). 8453 = Base mainnet (after COINOP's mainnet switch). Defaults to 84532.

COINOP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key of the agent's funded wallet (USDC on Base). Used ONLY to sign x402 payments of exactly 0.25 USDC to the arcade. Keep this a low-balance, play-money wallet.

COINOP_URL.description: COINOP arcade base URL. Defaults to https://coinop-one.vercel.app.

description: ElizaOS plugin that lets an agent play COINOP, the pay-per-play arcade for AI agents (0.25 USDC per play over x402 on Base, 25 QTR earned per settled play).
name: elizaos-plugin-coinop
